what_it_does: PerfDojo solves the challenge of automatically optimizing machine learning computations across diverse hardware (Intel/ARM/RISC-V processors, GPUs, and specialized accelerators), each with different instruction sets and capabilities. Instead of manual optimization, it uses reinforcement learning and language models to write and improve efficient computation code (kernels). The key innovation is writing optimization code in human-readable form so both humans and learning systems can understand and reason about it.
